title: icosinia paniculata
intro: Icosinia paniculata, commonly known as Chinese angelica or dong quai, is a perennial plant in the carrot family (Apiaceae) native to China. It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for centuries to promote women's health and alleviate symptoms of menopause, such as hot flashes and night sweats. The health benefits of Icosinia paniculata include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-estrogenic properties, which have been shown to support cardiovascular health and reduce the risk of certain cancers. The bioactive constituents of Icosinia paniculata include coumarins, ferulic acid, and ferulic esters, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions of reducing inflammation and improving circulation.
